purpose: Actual-genesis proof for the first two clean v3 stages; no receipt for the full v3 chain is issued

source_and_input_policy.isolated_run_root: Resolved root must be disjoint from source checkout; twelve monthly files, ranking, template and independently acquired NOAA weather are named and SHA-bound by the existing clean raw manifest before any value read.
source_and_input_policy.publication: Real modes require caller supplied SHA equal to this adapter's bytes and a Git HEAD tree containing this adapter, this spec, the pinned clean producer and original solution sources. This is an operator publication attestation, not an independent online GitHub check.
source_and_input_policy.execution: One original solution.py CLI per fresh exclusive stage, fixed 8 CPU threads and 900 round cap for training; child cwd is isolated root, all output paths remain under that root, 10 GiB physical RAM floor before heavy reads and child launch.
source_and_input_policy.transaction: Freeze source/raw SHA and prior actual transaction before launch; rehash before and after child and independent proof; link only verified outputs to canonical paths without overwrite, then write an exclusive stage transaction with actual command, log, inputs, output SHA and replay proof. A failed stage is not resumed.

baseline_train_replay.inputs: Independently reconstruct solution.load_data and build_features from exactly the sealed twelve 2025 raw files. Compare full saved feature and training row values/schema/order and assert no target/BLOCK/opaque ID predictor.
baseline_train_replay.split: Both original heldout month folds [1,7] and [11,12]; train on finite 0..86400 labels outside heldout, early stop on same-range heldout, score every finite heldout label. Store ordered fit/early/held ID and label SHA.
baseline_train_replay.models: Load the actual saved LightGBM direct and conditional residual fold models. Check feature names/tree counts against reported selected rounds, replay each OOF direct/raw proxy/hybrid vector exactly to float32, and recompute all fold metrics, pooled residual-share/alpha search and validation report. Check final full direct/residual model schema and median original-fold tree count, saved metadata and conditional residual presence.
baseline_train_replay.output: Promote exact training feature/row caches, both OOF, validation report, metadata and every generated saved LightGBM model (including conditional residual).

baseline_predict_replay.inputs: Before child launch, rehash and replay the canonical baseline_train transaction; link only its verified model.json/direct.txt/conditional residual.txt into a fresh prediction stage.
baseline_predict_replay.proof: Reconstruct ranking features and proxy from sealed ranking raw file; verify saved ranking feature/row caches, actual final LightGBM direct/residual predictions and fixed saved alpha/share formula, all prediction columns, exact 344841 template ID order, finite nonnegative selected values and proposal readback.
baseline_predict_replay.output: Promote ranking features/rows/predictions and the proposal Parquet exclusively; proposal is a local lineage artifact and never an upload.

remaining_full_v3_gap: No missing/grouped/weather/airport/tail/LIRF/ensemble/LOBT/LOBT-blend child can launch from this adapter. Their model/policy/OOF/ranking proofs and a separate aggregate v3 receipt are required before the clean_parent_producers reviewed_v3_proof_adapter_sha256 null pin can be replaced. The timestamp and GPU/source chain remain blocked.
